body:
I'm having this error as well on a default export:

```
Cannot map to variable name in module /path/to/my/file.ts (export 'default')
```

I tried putting together a quick example but was unable to reproduce it with a simple use case. Commenting here because I'm happy to provide more information if it would be helpful.
I have this same issue. I'm using https://github.com/marshallofsound/babel-preset-es2015-ie-native-modules. If I replace this with just the standard babel-preset-es2015 I don't get the error.
It would help to see how `COMMON_HEADERS` is defined.
It might be worth seeing if there's a circular dependency in your project: https://www.npmjs.com/package/circular-dependency-plugin

@epoberezkin - I'm open. Can you please elaborate a little as to why you think it's a circular dep? We've dealt with that issue before. 

Noting again that it works in WP2, the only change is adding this plugin:
```
Switching Webpack 2.6.1 to 3.0.0 works fine, no issues.
Build fails when adding ModuleConcatentationPlugin().
```
There are a lot of changes to module handling and the scope hoisting optimization is only applied to esm code I think... so a circular dep could cause a lot of trouble.
Got it, thanks @probablyup. Can you suggest a way to find our potential circular deps?  To date, we've waited for errors to pop up and patched as-needed.
See the plugin I linked a few comments up.
Heh, I'm a tube light. Yep, will try this tomorrow and report back. Thanks again.
We definitely have/need circular dependencies. I take it that just means no `ModuleConcatentationPlugin`.

No one "needs" circular dependencies. ESM strict implementations won't even
allow them.

Often times it's just a matter of breaking up your files into smaller
chunks.

Well, by "need" I only mean that our app currently depends heavily on them and we won't be able to design around this requirement soon. I otherwise agree with your theoretical assertion. :-)

> No one "needs" circular dependencies. ESM strict implementations won't even
> allow them.

Circular dependencies are allowed by the ESM spec. Implementations that doesn't allow circular dependencies are not spec conform. webpack and also the scope hoisting plugins allows circular dependencies. At least it should, if it doesn't this is a bug.

I had the same problem as well, with some circular dependencies. I've made a repository to show the bug.
https://github.com/Axnyff/reproduction.

yarn bundle (which just calls webpack produce the bug). Weirdly, if I comment at some lines in viewport-utils.js, it seems to work.

Here's another very minimal reproduction: https://github.com/mrdziuban/webpack-variable-name. With that I get:

```
ERROR in chunk main [entry]
dist.js
Cannot map to variable name in module /Users/matt/webpack-variable-name/b.js (export 'a')
```

It seems like the issue could be a combination of circular dependencies and [referencing the `global` namespace](https://github.com/mrdziuban/webpack-variable-name/blob/master/a.js#L8-L9). I was able to fix the issue in @axelnyffenegger's repo as well by commenting out [these two lines](https://github.com/Axnyff/reproduction/blob/master/viewport-utils.js#L9-L10).

@mrdziuban - nice.  Looks like referencing `global` creates an issue as long as it's in the dep graph? i.e. Even if the doesn't matter if the variable that failed to get mapped isn't related to the `global` reference, the bug might occur?

@probablyup - found some circular dependencies, and they relate directly to the files where the failed mapping is caught. :+1: Thanks for the tip.
```
ERROR in chunk main [entry]
scripts.bundle.js
Cannot map to variable name in module /Users/sdt/BlacklightProjects/te/frontend/src/app/domainData/api/entities/elements/index.js (export 'COMMON_HEADERS')

ERROR in Circular dependency detected:
frontend/src/app/domainData/entities/entities.js -> frontend/src/app/domainData/entities/pages/pages.js -> frontend/src/app/domainData/entities/entities.js

ERROR in Circular dependency detected:
frontend/src/app/domainData/entities/pages/pages.js -> frontend/src/app/domainData/entities/entities.js -> frontend/src/app/domainData/entities/pages/pages.js
```

@sokra , or anyone else on the WP team: what would be your advice for our team?  We can resolve these circluar deps to see if `ModuleConcatentationPlugin` will work, but it's a nontrivial refactor.  If there's bandwidth to fix it relatively quickly, this is also something we can wait on. Thanks!
